Deep Learning & Neural Networks.

COURSE EXPECTATION // QUESTION A

Deep Learning & Predictive Transparency

In this BSIT course, students develop technical proficiency across neural architectures, database management, and interpretable AI systems—pairing predictive models with deterministic validation to address the black-box challenge in production IT environments.

COURSE EXPECTATION // QUESTION B

Bridging Theory & Scalable Execution

Bridges mathematical foundations—tokenization, embeddings, and gradient optimization—with hands-on implementation in TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch while maintaining strict engineering and ethical standards.

01 // PERIOD 1 — FOUNDATIONAL NEURAL NETWORKS

Prelims

Foundational exercises covering tokenization, embeddings, no-code intent classification, and 20 structured Keras hyperparameter experiments (EXP-001–EXP-020).

Activity 01 · Week 2

WW-P2: Introduction to NLP Concepts

Completed Microsoft Learn's NLP module (passed assessment), comparing word/sub-word/character tokenization, TF-IDF, and contextual embeddings alongside hands-on testing of Phi-3.5-mini summarization and PII extraction.

Python NumPy Microsoft Learn
Activity 02 · Week 3

PT-P1: Deep Learning (Neural Networks)

Built a three-class intent classifier (Positive, Negative, Urgent Support) reaching 88.6% test accuracy on 35 unseen phrases and integrated it into a live MIT App Inventor ride-hailing chat analyzer.

ML for Kids MIT App Inventor 88.6% Accuracy
Activity 03 · Week 4

PT-P2: Neural Network Training (Hyperparameters)

Designed and trained a Keras Sequential network across 20 experiments (EXP-001–EXP-020), expanding N=35→500 and tuning learning rate (0.0003) & dropout (0.30) to close the generalization gap (val loss 0.3586).

TensorFlow Keras 20 Experiments

REPORTS // FULL TECHNICAL WRITE-UPS & REFLECTIONS

Activity Reports & Reflections

PRELIMS · ACTIVITY 01 · WEEK 2

WW-P2: Introduction to NLP Concepts

Key Reflection: Word-level tokens stay interpretable but choke on OOV terms; character tokens inflate sequence length; sub-word tokenization balances both. Production NLP requires deterministic validation layered over generative outputs.

TF-IDF vs Embeddings Phi-3.5-mini IEEE Report PDF
PRELIMS · ACTIVITY 02 · WEEK 3

PT-P1: No-Code Neural Text Classifier

Key Reflection: Reached 88.6% accuracy (80% Positive, 93.3% Negative, 90% Urgent). Feature extraction occurs during Learn & Test when raw tagged text converts into numerical tokens prior to weight updates.

35 Tagged Examples MIT App Inventor IEEE Report PDF
PRELIMS · ACTIVITY 03 · WEEK 4

PT-P2: Keras FFBP Hyperparameter Tuning

Key Reflection: N=35 caused severe memorization (1.54 generalization gap). Scaling to N=500 lifted validation accuracy to 86%, and adding 0.30 dropout at lr=0.0003 converged cleanly at 0.3586 validation loss.
